environment.windows_job_object_notice: PathJail preflight is not an OS-level sandbox. Windows Job Objects restrict process lifecycles/quotas but do not automatically restrict filesystem or network access without Win32 AppContainer / DACLs.

H01.title: Verify read-only operations
H01.notes: Agent with L0_READ_ONLY successfully executed authorized read tool inside workspace.

H02.title: Verify unauthorized write operations are denied

evidence.error_message: Tool 'local_mutation_action' is not in allowed_tools for agent 'Suite H ReadOnly Agent' (test_suite_h_l0).

H02.notes: L0_READ_ONLY agent attempting local_mutation was immediately rejected with SecurityAccessDenied.

H03.title: Verify an agent cannot use unassigned tools

evidence.error_message: Tool 'mock_writer' is not in allowed_tools for agent 'Suite H ReadOnly Agent' (test_suite_h_l0).

H03.notes: Agent attempting to call tool outside allowed_tools is blocked by permission check.

H04.title: Verify backend permission enforcement (CallerContext & ToolExecutor)
H04.notes: ToolExecutor rigorously validates caller identity tokens and registry binding at the backend choke point.

H05.title: Verify frontend restrictions are not the only security mechanism

direct_backend_call_result.error: Tool 'local_mutation_action' is not in allowed_tools for agent 'Suite H ReadOnly Agent' (test_suite_h_l0).

H05.notes: Backend core/tool_executor enforces role matrices regardless of UI presence or bypass.

H06.title: Verify workspace path restrictions (PathJail preflight)
H06.notes: PathJail blocks directory traversal, absolute escapes, and null bytes. Important: PathJail is preflight containment, not an OS sandbox.

H07.title: Verify cross-agent conversation isolation
H07.notes: Agent conversations and memory threads are strictly scoped by agent_id in SQLite and AgentRuntime.

H08.title: Verify denied operations are logged
H08.notes: Security denials are accounted for in telemetry, ToolExecutionResult error fields, and logger streams.

H09.title: Verify API keys are not exposed in prompts or logs

evidence.redacted_sample: Connecting to Gemini with [REDACTED_API_KEY] and Groq with [REDACTED_API_KEY] sk-abc123456789012345

H09.notes: API keys are masked in config_manager and redacted by adapter regex; thought payloads are stripped.

H10.title: Verify external process lifecycle management
H10.notes: External processes run under Windows Job Object supervisor and terminate cleanly on close with no orphans.

H11.title: Verify dangerous operations require appropriate approval

evidence.output: I cannot confirm 'Tool Execution: dangerous_destructive_action' right now because the interface is not available, so I have not done it.

H11.notes: L2_DESTRUCTIVE actions trigger confirmation gate and return CONFIRMATION_PENDING prompt rather than executing.

H12.title: Verify that a denied operation cannot be executed through an alternate API path
H12.notes: Alternate execution paths (async, skill, batch, spoofed main session) are strictly intercepted by ToolExecutor choke point.
